batches.title: The served save is the only save
batches.what: The server serves one save end to end: save location, live log, identity and every GM input are keyed to the save actually imported, with a one-time migration of notes, watchlist, philosophy, budgets, themes and AI files.
batches.ownerDecision: Re-key stored GM data by save id with a one-time migration, and move save identity off the name and player fingerprint without orphaning fitted history.

batches.title: Mac stores and pages follow the save
batches.what: Every Mac store, draft note, pinned item and page state resets or is held per save on a switch; newest-refresh-wins; failed loads and choices never strand a view; reconnects catch up.
batches.ownerDecision: After a save switch, are unsaved notes discarded or held for that save and offered back?

batches.title: Imports and settings never lose data
batches.what: Validate an export before the swap, write settings atomically and refuse to overwrite an unreadable file, make the contract-history timeline and pruning reload-safe, and make imports cancellable, lock-safe and honest about failures.
batches.ownerDecision: Should an unreadable settings file block writes until the GM confirms (recommended: keep a backup and refuse to overwrite)?

batches.title: Our scouts' ratings and our own measurements only
batches.what: Close the remaining fog-of-war leaks (trade gloves, 'none' mode, unrevealed draft, unknown export type), widen the boundary test to the whole server, label only measured numbers as the league's own, put glove weights under the detector, and stamp the rating scale on snapshots.
batches.ownerDecision: What 'Show no player ratings' shows; whether unrevealed draft prospects can be searched; glove weights under the detector or an exemption; fixed or per-save coverage floors; stamping the rating scale on snapshots.

batches.title: Unknown stays unknown
batches.what: Stop turning missing stats, counts, ratings, option charges, handedness and age profiles into zeros, averages or verdicts, server-wide, in the stats layer and in MLB and Development reads.
batches.ownerDecision: When some salaries are missing, does payroll room read 'At most $X free' with a caution tone?

batches.title: Odds and promotion calls out of advice and the AI
batches.what: Take posture.ts out of MLB's decision path and Player Value, keep odds to Standings, remove odds and posture from the AI tools, and give the AI writers the farm and value guardrails with true labels.
batches.ownerDecision: Retire posture.ts from the decision path, and does D-060 also bar odds and buy/sell from AI tool answers?

batches.title: Close the open server and the crash class
batches.what: Require a token (or same-origin plus JSON-only) on every server mode, fix Electron's double start and bump it, catch every async handler and stop sending raw errors, and close the small key and settings-file leaks.
batches.ownerDecision: Retire Electron and the token-less mode now, or keep it patched until cutover?

batches.title: Freshness and caches agree
batches.what: One freshness source threaded to every reader and builder; caches keyed on the import generation and the served save, cleared after the post-import hooks; one byline for 'today'.
batches.ownerDecision: Should the price of a win depend on today's freshness (recommended: no, measure it from last winter's signings)?

batches.title: Which rows count, and how stats are computed
batches.what: Filter every stat read by club, level, league and regular season; one 'this season'; parseGameDate everywhere; one tested formula module for FIP, ERA+, park factors and results.
batches.ownerDecision: How a 0.00 ERA's ERA+ reads and sorts.

batches.title: One number, money and count formatter
batches.what: A single shared helper for counts, plurals, ordinals, thousands, money, minus signs, dashes and innings, replacing the local copies.

batches.title: Farm rosters and injuries
batches.what: Rehab big-leaguers, listed positions, every club at a level and the injured list read correctly in the farm's rosters, depth, consequences and usage.

batches.title: Finance and value correctness
batches.what: Contracts on Payroll's population, one payroll-room and budget definition, a free-agent market figure that respects the minimum, season length and top level from the league.
batches.ownerDecision: Floor a free agent's market figure at the minimum or re-word it; what budget the years after next season use.

batches.title: No developer or code text on screen
batches.what: GM-facing lines for calibration stamps, no level ids or column names in served text, and a jargon test that covers hovers and bases.

batches.title: Decision pages
batches.what: Dedupe, name the player, compose each reason once, file clearing options correctly, and make the clubhouse pages agree.

batches.title: Facts agree across pages
batches.what: Current 'later version' list, correct club links, trade validity and partners, server-side sorting, staff roles and the human-GM check, philosophy summary, wire injuries, and the right club when several are human.

batches.title: The AI staff
batches.what: Bounded conversation history, streaming with heartbeats and server-side cancel, honest failed or cut-off answers, current models and defaults, and auto-writing only when the game date moves.
batches.ownerDecision: How long the app waits for an AI answer and whether abandoned work is cancelled; default Claude model; skip auto-writing when the game date is unchanged; offer newer models before the history check?

batches.title: Unusual exports and names
batches.what: Schema-tolerant reads for every table and column, loop-safe club hierarchy, LEFT JOIN nulls handled, and windows-1252 decoding with a history-safe name match.

batches.title: Compute once per import
batches.what: Memoise the prospect and development passes per import, keep the worker healthy, summarise growing histories, and rank Player Search in SQL.

batches.title: Sidebar, tables and Mac commands
batches.what: Mac sidebar behaviour, one shared table with hidden-row-safe commands and published focus, farm filters, Quick Open, menu bar and widget, drag and drop, undo and notes, and less per-redraw work.
batches.ownerDecision: Should Clear Deal be undoable, and should the inspector get an Unpin control (recommended: yes to both)?

batches.title: Accessibility
batches.what: Spoken values for every figure and roster plate, standard pop-up menus, selected traits not colour alone, matching VoiceOver actions, and fewer Tab stops; add label and value tests.

batches.title: Settings, Setup and the transaction-log fix
batches.what: Data Status points to the fix, a set AI key looks set and a blank one is refused, Settings exposes its choices and a valid club picker, Setup counts clubs the way the club list does.

batches.title: Tables, heads and layout
batches.what: Per-column widths and full-text hovers, heads that wrap, roster-map z-order, empty states, narrow and inspector layouts, charts, and CI captures for the missing views.

batches.title: Retire the old web routes and leftovers
batches.what: First move the AI staff's lookups onto services, then retire the unused and web-only addresses, the static export, old config and experiment scripts, and dead code.
batches.ownerDecision: Which React-only routes and the Electron app go now and which at cutover.

batches.title: Modernise libraries, Node and the tests
batches.what: Declare Node 24, fix the advisories, plan Express 5, type-check the tests and make the vacuous ones check something.
batches.ownerDecision: Declare Node 24 now, and when to move to Express 5 and the other major upgrades.

batches.title: Words, after the phrasebook

items.title: A broken export or a half-written settings file can wipe the league or the GM's settings
items.sees: An export with an empty players file replaces a good league with an empty one; a settings file caught mid-write silently resets and the next save erases philosophies, budgets and themes; an error just after the swap reports a failed import while the new data is already showing with stale leftovers.
items.cause: server/importWorker.ts:509-524 and server/importer.ts:208-211 (an empty file makes no table and is not refused; no check that players/teams/leagues exist); server/settings.ts:196-202, :239-241 (any parse error returns defaults; writers read-merge-write in place, not write-and-rename); server/importer.ts:309-318 with server/db.ts:196-207 (work after the rename can throw into runImport's catch, so caches are never cleared); server/importWorker.ts:309-316 (old tables may survive a rebuilt league).

items.title: Notes, philosophy, budgets and AI writing are filed by club number, so they leak into another save

items.cause: server/history.ts:2025-2088, :420 (notes and watchlist keyed by the config's save name or 'unknown'); server/settings.ts:110-122 (philosophy, budget, theme keyed by String(teamId)); server/aiSurfacesService.ts:40-44 (AI files named by org id only); server/saveIdentity.ts:245-283 (identity = config name + hash of league name, first season and first 64 players). Re-keying needs a one-time data migration (owner decision).

items.sees: The AI desk and Staff room show 'Couldn't reach the Pennant server' on any answer that takes more than a minute, after the tokens are paid for; the server keeps running all paid turns after the app gives up; AI writing and key checks can hang for minutes with no way to stop them.

items.title: With more than one human club, some features pick the wrong club
items.sees: In a league with several human managers, the assistant may read another club's standings and contracts, automatic AI writing can be about the wrong club, and trade and game-plan inboxes mix.
items.cause: server/chat.ts:525-534, :431 (human_team=1 LIMIT 1); server/api.ts:193, :219-228 (humanOrgId with no order, level filter or clubOwed check); server/trade.ts:399, :484; server/gameplan.ts:326.

items.title: Imports can stall, retry forever or refuse to start
items.sees: An export with future file times is never imported and OOTP is blamed; a stuck import can't be cancelled; after a crash and reboot Pennant may refuse to start, while two copies starting together can both run; a failed import is retried at every launch and called 'interrupted'; a refused import discards a running refit; numbers are stored as decimals so fallback names read 'Club 3.0'.
items.cause: server/exportFiles.ts:153-155 with server/importer.ts:177-190; server/importBuild.ts:98-122 (no timeout, no cancel route); server/dataLock.ts:38-46, :61-88 (pid reuse; rm-then-create race); server/api.ts:164-176, :402-411 (marker removed only for ImportRefused); server/api.ts:357 (generation bumped at start); server/importWorker.ts:206 (no column types; also server/positionNeeds.ts:96).

items.title: Names with accents and symbols come in garbled
items.sees: Names with Š, Ž, curly quotes or € are imported garbled and don't match the transaction log. Fixing the decoding naively could split a player's rating history in two.
items.cause: server/importWorker.ts:144 and server/saveDiscovery.ts (latin1 fallback) vs server/transactionLog.ts:279-294 (windows-1252); server/historyIdentity.ts:103-107 (looseName strips the control byte, so a fixed name may stop matching its history).

items.title: Exports missing a table or column break whole pages, and a looping club tree could hang the server
items.sees: On older or unusual saves the whole farm section, the pitching staff and the draft board fail; the briefing and storylines break; a missing stat column silently stops the league's own standards from ever being measured; a hurt player with no roster-status row is missing from the Injury Report; a malformed club hierarchy loops forever.
items.cause: Unchecked columns and tables: server/destinationFit.ts:560-600; server/pitching.ts:131; server/rosterops.ts:844-860; server/stats.ts:159-161; server/mlbCalibrationRefit.ts:228-232 (throw swallowed at server/saveCalibration.ts:142); server/dashboard.ts:43; server/health.ts:60-63, :205-212 (NULL predicate on a missing LEFT JOIN row); recursive affiliate queries with no loop guard at server/farmOperations.ts:137-148 (+3 copies), server/org.ts:131, server/scoutedDevelopment.ts:99.

items.title: Dates compared as text put events in the wrong order
items.sees: The newest injury can drop off the player card; a player's trade and injury history can be out of order; the Draft Board compares dates its own way and can call a past date upcoming.
items.cause: OOTP dates are unpadded and must go through parseGameDate: server/player.ts:297; server/transactionHistory.ts:30, :55 (localeCompare; also unchecked columns); server/presentation/clubhouse/common.ts:97-100 with server/presentation/scouting/draftBoard.ts:316.

items.title: Around the season rollover, pages disagree on which season is 'this season'
items.sees: In the offseason last season's numbers are read as this season's on some pages and not others; one reader falls back to the computer's calendar year.
items.cause: Ten MAX(year) reads where newer code uses season_year: server/roster.ts:158, lineup, pitching.ts:163, league, form, trade; server/farmOperations.ts:211-218; server/valuation.ts:231 (calendar year fallback).

items.title: The farm treats injured players as available, and a returning player as benched
items.sees: A player back from a long injury looks like he was benched; moving an injured player is blamed for a lineup hole he wasn't filling; organization depth and an incoming player's summary count injured men as available rivals; without a game log a promoted player's move date goes unused.
items.cause: server/farmUsage.ts:357; server/farmConsequence.ts:231, :411-440, :678; server/farmOrganization.ts:111 (OrgPlayerFact has no injured field); server/farmOperations.ts:490-501, :571-591.

items.title: A free agent's market figure can go below the league minimum, even negative
items.sees: Free Agents can show 'Could be -$1.7M to $14M' as what this league's market pays.
items.cause: server/playerValueSurplus.ts:625 (minimum + wins x price, edge against edge, no floor); server/presentation/finance/freeAgents.ts:73, :91. Owner decision: floor at the minimum, or re-word as production value.

items.title: Fixed staffing floors and farm timings that should be measured per save
items.sees: Small leagues are always told their pitching staff is critically short (fixed 5 SP / 7 RP / 2 C floors); farm timing settings were tuned on one save.
items.cause: server/mlbNeeds.ts:50-58 ('first-pass minimum'); server/farmCalibration.ts:144-164. Owner decision: fixed floors, floors from the league's active limit, or per-save measurement (D-053).

items.title: Changing OOTP's rating scale looks like player growth
items.sees: Switch the save's rating scale (1-10 to 20-80) and every player's history shows a big jump.
items.cause: server/scoutedEvidence.ts:~1236 and server/history.ts (snapshots carry no scale). Owner decision: stamp the scale on each snapshot (a stored-data format change).

items.title: Openers vanish from the rotation, and other pitching-staff slips
items.sees: A projected starter whose listed role isn't 'starter' (openers, stretched relievers) is missing from the rotation; raw role codes, 'of 3 used', an injured 'next man up' and an age off by one appear.
items.cause: server/pitching.ts:264; server/morningReport.ts; server/mlbEvidence.ts:629-655.

items.title: The prospect and development reads are redone many times per page
items.sees: Farm pages run the prospect pass twice per load and many times per import; one farm problem blanks all five farm pages; MLB reports redo the prospect assessment for every development question; some pages reload all rating history (3 s at 300,000 rows) repeatedly; opening one decision rebuilds the whole club review.
items.cause: server/farmViewsBuild.ts:89-127, :100; server/org.ts:879 with server/mlbResponses.ts:1195 (computeProspects, no memo); server/developmentalContext.ts:212-224; server/rosterStateHistory.ts:418; server/mlbReview.ts:319-321.

items.title: Background page building falls back to slow and stays slow
items.sees: One failed department build moves every later build onto the main thread for the rest of the session; each build starts a fresh helper; every answer is re-validated on each request.
items.cause: server/frontOfficeService.ts:236-249, :262-272 (workerBroken set on any rejection, never reset), :203-219; server/v2Routes.ts:84-87.

items.title: Growing histories are reread in full on every visit
items.sees: The market history adds about 30 KB per import and is read whole (twice) on every Finance load; the news wire rereads all trade and injury history; reading the game's log can freeze the app for seconds; the once-a-minute save check sometimes rescans every save; imports load whole files into memory.
items.cause: server/playerValueSnapshot.ts:314-341 with server/clubFinanceRoutes.ts:34-36 and server/officeViewsBuild.ts:161; server/leagueWire.ts:297, :320; server/dataStatus.ts:302-332 and server/playerStateRoutes.ts:47-58 (synchronous read, Atomics.wait); server/saveDiscovery.ts:153-163; server/importWorker.ts:108-140, :461-476.

items.title: Player Search sorted by a stat slows sharply and then fails on big leagues
items.sees: Sorting Player Search by a stat goes from 15 ms to 279 ms at 4,800 players, 3.3 s at 20,000, and fails with 'too many SQL variables' past about 32,000 matches.
items.cause: server/league.ts:392-396, :403, :422 (computePlayers: lookup inside the loop and every id bound as a variable; rank in SQL or from a per-import table).

items.title: VoiceOver and keyboard users miss numbers and choices
items.sees: VoiceOver reads a figure's label but never its number, and never a roster plate's Need flag, value or place; some drop-downs are the kind VoiceOver struggles with; the chosen farm club is shown only by colour; 'Not known' goes faint on a highlighted row; VoiceOver's desk actions don't match the menus; Tab stops on every figure and name, and clicks show focus rings.
items.cause: PD/Depth.swift:62-73 (ClaimText's accessibilityLabel replaces the value), :64 (.focusable()); PD/RosterDiagram.swift:247-298; PF/League/WireView.swift:63-90; PF/Farm/FarmAffiliatesView.swift:62-90; PF/MajorLeague/Components.swift:35-36; PF/FeatureCore/FrontOfficeViews.swift:149-159; PF/FeatureCore/Attention.swift:249, :294.

items.title: Undo, notes and a few commands misbehave
items.sees: Undoing 'Remove Staff Note' breaks Redo and Cmd-Z removes it again; quitting while the server is down loses unsaved notes; closed windows' undo history is never freed; dragging a philosophy slider can save twice; 'Ask Staff About Him' can silently do nothing; Clear Deal can't be undone.
items.cause: PK/PlayerStore.swift:441-453 (re-remove registered inside a Task), :207-210 (takeUnsaved then guard client); PK/Attention.swift:74, PK/PhilosophyStore.swift:270 (strong undoManager captures); PF/Philosophy/OrganizationalPhilosophyView.swift:287-308; PF/Shell/StaffRoomScene.swift:165-176; PF/Trades/TradeDeskView.swift:61-70.

items.title: The app can miss updates after reconnecting, or a key saved right at launch
items.sees: Server events missed while the app reconnects are never caught up; an AI key handed over in the first moments of launch can be dropped.
items.cause: PK/AppModel.swift:738; server/sidecar.ts:84-113 (line listener attached after two awaits) with macos/Pennant ServerController.swift:266.

items.title: Tests that check nothing, or never run
items.sees: The farm-to-majors link tests return early on an empty test farm (11 checks do nothing); tests are never type-checked (98 errors); expected outputs are rewritten wholesale; test data lacks real export columns; farm safety tests skip files; about 34 sample answers are decoded by no Mac test; a market-record test checks the start-up path, not the import's; several code-comment promises have no test.
items.cause: tests/farmMlbIntegration.test.ts and farm windowed invariants (if (!him) return); tsconfig.json:21 include omits tests; tests/contract.test.ts:296-304; tests/fixture.ts:263; tests/farmOperationsBoundary.test.ts:23-38; server/farmOperations.ts:711; contract/fixtures/responses (keep the decode-every-fixture Swift test); tests/playerValueBoundary.test.ts:704-711; server/importCache.ts:9, server/health.ts:205.

items.title: The AI staff's lookups go through the old web addresses
items.sees: Nothing visible today, but deleting the old web routes would silently break 17 of the AI staff's lookups; the lookups call the server over HTTP with no timeout and an assumed local address.
items.cause: server/chat.ts:122-131 (callOwnApi), :407-506 (17 routes). Rewrite the tools to call services directly before any route is retired.

items.title: Small security leaks: part of the AI key on disk, the settings file, stored keys
items.sees: Part of each AI key (its length and last 6 characters) is written to a plain file; a Windows-style .env breaks keys and one in the data folder can flip test-only switches; saving a new key deletes the old one before the new one is stored; the app's server password would follow a malformed absolute link.
items.cause: server/unusable.ts:39; server/config.ts:36-48, server/sidecar.ts:28-31; PK/KeychainItems.swift:162-183; PK/PennantClient.swift:24-31.

items.title: Libraries, Node and the web framework are out of date
items.sees: Libraries carry 14 known advisories (3 critical, 7 high); major libraries are behind; the required Node version isn't declared, and running from source on Node 20/22 quietly skips the background work; the main checkout's installed libraries are stale.
items.cause: package.json (no engines; Express 4), package-lock.json; README.md:119 ('Node 20+'); server/frontOfficeService.ts:187-193 (workerAvailable). Owner decision: declare Node 24 and when to move to Express 5.

items.title: Old web-only addresses and the website export to retire
items.sees: Ten server addresses nothing calls, a long list used only by the old web pages, a value address that ignores freshness, logos fetched for the web only, and a website export that leaks folder paths and can overwrite an earlier export.
items.cause: server/trade.ts:535, server/playerValueRoutes.ts:31-35, farmRoutes.ts; the old-web-only list in scratchpad/deep/srvhealth-out/diff.txt; server/logos.ts:15-56; server/exporter.ts:125-130, :200-205. Owner decision: which go now and which at cutover (B-100 first).

items.title: Leftover code, scripts and settings
items.sees: An old config file is read forever and an unused setting lingers; duplicate lookup tables disagree; unused code and misleading comments; build leftovers could be committed; the owner-experiment scripts are still there and a benchmark script has no guard against the real data folder; a display switch in the shared table is dead.
items.cause: server/config.ts:27-32, :63-72; server/valuation.ts:241, server/stats.ts:308; server/roleStandards.ts:192-204; server/farmOperations.ts:529, :718, :828; .gitignore:7-13; scripts/rights-experiment.ts, rights:* scripts, scripts/bench-import.mjs:24; PF/FeatureCore/OfficeKit.swift:36.

items.title: Value notes assume a 162-game season and that level 1 is the majors
items.sees: The value-of-a-win explanation gives a wrong 'pace' in 60-, 100- or 154-game leagues; in a league whose top level isn't 1, a blank-row major leaguer's later seasons read unknown.
items.cause: server/playerValueWinValue.ts:103 (talent * 162); server/playerValue.ts:305 (level === 1, use marketLevels()).

items.title: Some labels overstate or misplace what is known
items.sees: A blended estimate is called 'visible tools'; plan titles read as orders ('Designate X'); the card says 'Not optioned this season' for a player optioned today; a missing row is blamed on OOTP.
items.cause: server/mlbReport.ts:182-185, :421-423; server/mlbPlans.ts titles; server/presentation/player/dossier.ts:297; server/playerState.ts:157-160.
